title: MyDoc
description: An open-source markdown based editor designed for simplicity. Offers a clean, minimal writing space. Everything is autosaved locally and never leaves your device, with options to export as PDF, DOCX, or RTF.

title: MyDE
description: A simplem local-first editor that allows you to use any LLM of your choice and saves automatically everything - projects, preferences - to your localstorage. Useful for prototyping quick landing pages and simple web apps with AI, includes a full-featured code editor as well as download and export to github features.

title: Dictionary
description: Minimal but functional dictionary built with NextJS Pages Router and a third-party API

title: Spinnn
description: Simple spinning wheel app I created with React and Vite. Nothing special - just option and color customization, and localstorage recording

title: Vistab
description: Chrome new tab extension with a modern interface and video background capabilities as well as bookmarks and to-do list
